name: behaviour-hive-demo-video
description: Isolated tooling for the three-track backup demo video. Deliberately NOT a dependency of the root package.json -- Vercel installs every root devDependency on every production build, and ffmpeg-static alone is ~80MB. This nested package.json keeps that weight (and its own node_modules) out of the app entirely; it's only ever installed and run from a developer's machine.
